doc.name: A — tableware catalogue, mirror tunnel, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: reactive-glaze dinner plate stack
Category: tableware
Shot programme: mirror tunnel
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director signing off every frame of this tableware campaign. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the in-context lifestyle in a mirror tunnel treatment.

SUBJECT. A reactive-glaze dinner plate stack. Copy the product from the reference verbatim in form and finish. If a detail is unreadable in the reference, keep it neutral rather than inventing one.

CAMERA. Product in its real use environment with lived-in supporting props. Shoot on a 14mm ultra-wide at f/22, framing for a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows. Stage the product on or against burnished brass, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
